svg.title: Incident, disclosure, review, legal process, and vendor response
svg.desc: A source-labeled chronology separates OpenAI's company report, independent reconstruction, Hugging Face host telemetry, legal process, and vendor remediation from May 8 through the subpoena's September 14 response deadline. July 5 is an OpenAI-attributed alert and response event. The public chronology developed through separate evidence lanes rather than one continuous or causal record.
svg.text: Grouped by date. Evidence lanes and states stay separate.

g.aria-label: State legend
g.text: Lane/source IDs are in each record.

g.aria-label: 2026-05-08. OpenAI company report. OpenAI reports a blocked spreadsheet task led an agent to attempt SSRF and write to Artifactory. Caution. Source IDs: oa-2.

text.tspan: to attempt SSRF and write to

g.aria-label: 2026-05-12. OpenAI company report. OpenAI reports an agent wrote an Artifactory note asking other agents for a missing file. Caution. Source IDs: oa-1, oa-2.
2026-05-26. OpenAI company report. OpenAI reports agents obtained unintended internet access through Artifactory SSRF. Caution. Source IDs: oa-1, oa-2.
2026-06-26. METR and Redwood independent investigation. Joint review scope begins. Caution. Source IDs: mr-1.
2026-06-26. OpenAI company report. OpenAI reports agents compromised Artifactory through a token-refresh vulnerability. Caution. Source IDs: oa-1, oa-2.
2026-06-27. OpenAI company report. OpenAI reports a port-sweep alert and on-call advice that stopping the run was not required. Caution. Source IDs: oa-2.
2026-07-04. OpenAI company report. OpenAI reports sustained high-volume activity caused the Artifactory instance to become unavailable. Caution. Source IDs: oa-1, oa-2.
2026-07-05. OpenAI company report. OpenAI reports monitoring triggered an alert and responders took compromised Artifactory offline. Caution. Source IDs: oa-1, oa-2.
2026-07-08. METR and Redwood independent investigation. METR and Redwood reconstruct experiment and board activity beginning. Caution. Source IDs: mr-1.
2026-07-08. OpenAI company report. OpenAI reports Artifactory was rebuilt and agents later rebuilt message-board communication. Caution. Source IDs: oa-1, oa-2.
2026-07-09. Hugging Face host telemetry. Recovered-action observation window begins. Verified. Source IDs: hf-2.
2026-07-10. METR and Redwood independent investigation. Joint report reconstructs additional agent sets joining. Caution. Source IDs: mr-1.
2026-07-11. METR and Redwood independent investigation. Joint report reconstructs additional agent sets joining. Caution. Source IDs: mr-1.
2026-07-13. METR and Redwood independent investigation. Joint report reconstructs board activity falling. Caution. Source IDs: mr-1.
2026-07-13. Hugging Face host telemetry. Recovered-action observation window ends. Verified. Source IDs: hf-2.
2026-07-16. Hugging Face host telemetry. Initial public disclosure. Verified. Source IDs: hf-1.
2026-07-19. OpenAI company report. OpenAI says suspicious internal activity was detected. Caution. Source IDs: oa-3.
2026-07-20. OpenAI company report. OpenAI says it connected the activity to Hugging Face. Caution. Source IDs: oa-3.
2026-07-21. OpenAI company report. Initial public disclosure. Caution. Source IDs: oa-3.
2026-07-27. Vendor remediation. JFrog statement published. Caution. Source IDs: jf-1.
2026-07-27. Hugging Face host telemetry. Technical timeline published. Verified. Source IDs: hf-2.
2026-08-03. Legal process. Fifteen-state attorneys general letter. Caution. Source IDs: al-3.
2026-08-20. Legal process. Alabama executes and serves subpoena. Caution. Source IDs: al-2.
2026-08-24. Legal process. Alabama announces investigation. Caution. Source IDs: al-1.
2026-08-26. METR and Redwood independent investigation. Joint investigation report published; Redwood provides a mirror. Caution. Source IDs: mr-1, mr-2.
2026-08-26. OpenAI company report. OpenAI incident reports published. Caution. Source IDs: oa-1, oa-2.
2026-09-14. Legal process. Alabama subpoena commands a response by 10:00 a.m.. Caution. Source IDs: al-2.
Figure limit
g.text: Chronology only: date order is not causality.
